北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感-12℃，多穿衣物，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels like -12℃. Dress warmly to stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪下雨啦，体感 3℃，带好雨具，小心路滑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, it's raining and feels like 3℃. Take your umbrella and watch your step!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，体感 1℃，能见度低，出行请注意安全。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and feels like 1℃. Low visibility, please travel safely.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州有霾，出门佩戴口罩，保护呼吸道健康。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has haze. Wear a mask when going out for respiratory health.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 18℃，享受好天气哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 18℃. Enjoy the lovely weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力 4级，体感-4℃，记得添衣保暖，别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou, it feels like -4℃ with 4-level wind. Dress warm and avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感-4℃，有点冷，多穿点，注意防寒哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -4℃, quite cold. Dress warmly to stay protected from the cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃，出门多添一件衣服，别冷着。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 3℃. Add a layer when going out to stay warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感-6℃，注意防风保暖，谨防感冒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like -6℃. Guard against wind and cold, prevent catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安雨夹雪，体感-6℃，路面湿滑，注意安全哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an, it's sleeting and feels like -6℃. Roads are slippery, please be safe.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度高，体感 6℃，别忘了保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with high humidity, feels like 6℃. Don't forget to stay warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-29℃，务必严实保暖，谨防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -29℃. Please dress very warmly to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-25℃，天晴也寒冷，多穿点哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -25℃. It's sunny but freezing, dress warmly!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 15℃，享受美好时光吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 15℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门天晴，体感 13℃，舒适宜人，开心出门！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels like 13℃. Pleasant and comfortable, enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大，体感-12℃，请加厚衣物，防风御寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and feels like -12℃. Bundle up to guard against wind and cold.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风大，体感-18℃，外出务必严密保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is windy and feels like -18℃. Bundle up thoroughly when going out.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
